title: PlumSMP
description: PlumSMP offers smooth lag free gameplay with a friendly community active staff regular reward events fair play and game modes like Practice PVP RandomKits Survival and Lifesteal
body:
**Welcome to PlumSMP**

**🎮 PlumSMP is a PvP-focused Minecraft server where you can build your base, grind resources, and compete against other players in a competitive survival environment.**

**🔥 Features**
- Competitive Survival gameplay
- PvP combat and leaderboards
- Player-driven economy
- Regular events with rewards
- Active staff and moderated community

**🌍 Why Join?**
- Smooth, lag-free gameplay
- Friendly and active community
- Fair play environment (no toxicity)

**🧭 Supported Versions**
- Java Edition: 1.20+
- Bedrock Edition supported (Port: 19132)

**🚀 How to Join**

Java Edition:**
1. Open Minecraft
2. Go to Multiplayer
3. Click “Add Server”
4. Enter: PlumSMP.net
5. Join the server

**Bedrock Edition:**
- Server Address: plumsmp.net
- Port: 19132

**📌 Server Info**
- IP: PlumSMP.net
- Port: 19132

**🤝 Need Help?**
- Use /help in-game
- Open a support ticket on our Discord

**👥 Staff Applications**
Apply to join the team, help players, and support the community.

**🚀 Grind • Compete • Dominate**
